name: Bouncer
description: Gemini stands at the door. Independent quality gate that audits an AI agent's output and returns a 0-10 score, issues list, and PASS/FAIL verdict. Built to catch unverified claims before they ship.

audit.label: Audit Output
audit.description: Score an AI agent's final response with Gemini as an independent reviewer. Returns score/10, issues, and PASS/FAIL.

inputs.name: assistant_text
inputs.label: Assistant Output
inputs.description: The full text the agent produced and wants audited.

inputs.name: diff_text
inputs.label: Code Diff (optional)
inputs.description: Optional git diff to ground coding-task audits against real changes.

inputs.name: task_context
inputs.label: Task Context (optional)
inputs.description: Optional context: user request, project rules, workplan.

inputs.name: model
inputs.label: Gemini Model
inputs.description: Gemini model to use for scoring.
